Alabaster Lord's Sword.location: Drops from the Alabaster Lord in the Lake of Rot (raise the platforms near the end of the lake and climb the cliff west of the Grand Cloister); a second drops from the Alabaster Lord in Yelough Anix Tunnel.

Ancient Meteoric Ore Greatsword.location: Examine the altar in Ruined Forge Starfall Past; pull the lever to raise the iron door and jump across to the second level where the altar sits.

Antspur Rapier.location: Guaranteed drop from Maleigh Marais, Shaded Castle Castellan, found just west of the Shaded Castle with a Guardian Golem.

Anvil Hammer.location: Found at Ruined Forge Lava Intake.

Arbalest.location: On a corpse behind an Exile Soldier manning an explosive ballista, reached by jumping a gap on the rampart past the Rampart Tower.

Astrologer's Staff.location: Sold by the Nomadic Merchant at the Liurnia Lake Shore Site of Grace for 800 Runes; also starting gear for the Astrologer class.

Axe of Godrick.location: Trade the Remembrance of the Grafted (from Godrick the Grafted) to Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold.

Azur's Glintstone Staff.location: In a secluded room on the highest level of the Church of the Cuckoo, reached via the rooftops of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

Banished Knight's Greatsword.location: Drops from sword-and-shield Banished Knights, e.g. in Stormveil Castle southwest of the Rampart Tower; also outside Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid.

Banished Knight's Halberd.location: Dropped by a halberd-wielding Banished Knight near the Rampart Tower Site of Grace in Stormveil Castle; +8 version dropped by Edgar.

Barbed Staff-Spear.location: Dropped by Jori, Elder Inquisitor in the Darklight Catacombs.

Bastard Sword.location: Sold for 3,000 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant at the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace.

Battle Hammer.location: Drops from hammer-wielding Grave Warden Duelists in Leyndell (they stop spawning after Maliketh).

Beast Claw.location: Dropped by Logur, the Beast Claw, in the southern part of Gravesite Plain on the way to the Church of Consolation.

Beast-Repellent Torch.location: Sold by the Isolated Merchant in the Isolated Merchant's Shack in north-west Dragonbarrow for 1,200 Runes.

Beastclaw Greathammer.location: Awarded by Gurranq, Beast Clergyman at the Bestial Sanctum for feeding him 7 Deathroot.

Beastman's Cleaver.location: Drops from cleaver-wielding Beastmen in Crumbling Farum Azula; also from a Beastman at the Four Belfries Crumbling Lands waygate.

Beastman's Curved Sword.location: Drops from curved-sword-wielding Azula Beastmen, e.g. the seven near the Crumbling Beast Grave Site of Grace.

Black Steel Greathammer.location: Guaranteed drop from the Black Knight at the Church of Consolation.

Black Steel Twinblade.location: Guaranteed drop from the Black Knight at the western hill camp beside the encampment in front of Shadow Keep (northeast of Church of the Crusade).

Blade of Calling.location: In a hidden room reachable only during the elevator ride down to the Forbidden Lands Site of Grace; jump from the southwestern part of the elevator to a doorway near the bottom.

Bloodfiend's Arm.location: Drops from one of a group of Bloodfiends in Prospect Town, Gravesite Plain.

Bloodfiend's Fork.location: Random drop from Bloodfiends in Prospect Town, Rivermouth Cave, Stone Coffin Fissure and Rauh Base.

Bloodfiend's Sacred Spear.location: Picked up after defeating a Bloodfiend Hexer in the small pond west of Taylew's Ruined Forge in Rauh Base.

Bloodstained Dagger.location: Drops from Fierce Demi-Humans; one sits asleep near the bridge west of the South of the Lookout Tower Site of Grace.

Bone Bow.location: At the bottom of the spiral-staircase tower at the northwestern edge of Belurat, guarded by two giant Spider Scorpions.

Bonny Butchering Knife.location: Loot below a small shed outside a house east of the Bonny Village Site of Grace, just west of the broken bridge in the central ravine.

Brick Hammer.location: On a corpse in Stormveil Castle near the room where you get trapped with a Banished Knight, reached by jumping across a gap.

Broadsword.location: Sold by the Nomadic Merchant southeast of Coastal Cave (beneath the collapsed structure); also Confessor starting gear.

Butchering Knife.location: Drops from Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater, who invades outside the Corpse-Stench Shack on Mt. Gelmir.

Caestus.location: Sold by Gatekeeper Gostoc (at Stormveil Castle) for 800 Runes.

Cane Sword.location: On a corpse next to the stairs just south of the West Capital Rampart Site of Grace in Leyndell.

Carian Knight's Sword.location: Held by a carriage in northwest Liurnia, between the Northern Liurnia Lake Shore and the Four Belfries.

Celebrant's Cleaver.location: Drops from cleaver-wielding Dominula Dancers in Dominula, Windmill Village, in northern Altus Plateau.

Celebrant's Rib-Rake.location: Drops from Dominula Dancers in Dominula, Windmill Village, northern Altus Plateau.

Celebrant's Sickle.location: Drops from the blue Dominula Dancers in Dominula, Windmill Village; two are just east of the Windmill Village Site of Grace.

Celebrant's Skull.location: On a corpse at the end of a narrow ledge northeast of and below the Windmill Village Site of Grace in Dominula.

Chainlink Flail.location: Dropped by Mad Pumpkin Head enemies that wield it (no single fixed location).

Chilling Perfume Bottle.location: In Lamenter's Gaol (accessed from Charo's Hidden Grave): open the first locked door with the Upper Gaol Key, descend the ladder onto the frozen floor; in the room a Jar Innards emerges from.

Cinquedea.location: On a body far down the cliff west of the Bestial Sanctum, on the same level as the Dragoncrest Shield Talisman.

Cipher Pata.location: Jump over the balcony rail in the Roundtable Hold; it is in the rooms to the left.

Clawmark Seal.location: Given by Gurranq, Beast Clergyman at the Bestial Sanctum after feeding him 1 Deathroot.

Claws of Night.location: Dropped by the invading Swordhand of Night Anna on the approach to the hanging bell of the Finger Ruins (Finger Ruins of Rhia).

Claymore.location: In a building in Castle Morne's courtyard; from the Castle Morne Lift take the elevator up, then climb the pile of bodies in the courtyard.

Cleanrot Knight's Sword.location: Drops from Cleanrot Knights; the Swamp of Aeonia in Caelid is littered with them. Also in the Shaded Castle, Elphael and Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs.

Club.location: Sold by the Nomadic Merchant in western Limgrave (southeast of Coastal Cave) for 600 Runes; also Wretch starting gear and a Demi-Human drop.

Commander's Standard.location: Dropped by Commander O'Neil in the Swamp of Aeonia, Caelid.

Composite Bow.location: Sold for 3,500 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant down an incline north of Bellum Church in northern Liurnia.

Cranial Vessel Candlestand.location: In Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave, behind the second imp statue in the dungeon.

Crepus's Black-Key Crossbow.location: Behind a Stonesword Key fog door in the Roundtable Hold, down the stairs in the eastern wing past Smithing Master Hewg (with 20 Black-Key Bolts).

Cross-Naginata.location: Looted from a body in Gael Tunnel.

Crystal Knife.location: In a chest in the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel; after the first elevator, cross the wooden beam to the second room on the right guarded by two Marionette Soldiers.

Crystal Spear.location: In a chest behind an illusory wall in Sellia Hideaway, Caelid.

Crystal Sword.location: Found after the bridge from the Village of the Albinaurics Site of Grace in Liurnia.

Curseblade's Cirque.location: Drops from Curseblades; an easy one walks down the stairs from the Stagefront Site of Grace in Belurat. Also in Gravesite Plain, Scadu Altus and Ancient Ruins of Rauh.

Curved Club.location: Chance to drop from Albinauric enemies that wield it (no single fixed location).

Dagger.location: Sold by the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 400 Runes; also drops from dagger-wielding enemies.

Dancing Blade of Ranah.location: Dropped by the Dancer of Ranah inside the Southern Nameless Mausoleum.

Dane's Footwork.location: Pillaged from Dryleaf Dane's corpse after the Miquellan Loyalists / Leda and allies boss fight in Enir-Ilim.

Dark Moon Greatsword.location: At the end of Ranni's questline, where she sat beneath the Cathedral of Manus Celes, after giving her the Dark Moon Ring.

Deadly Poison Perfume Bottle.location: Purchased from Thiollier for 6,000 Runes (or later from Moore / the Twin Maiden Husks).

Death Knight's Longhaft Axe.location: Dropped by the Death Knight at Scorpion River Catacombs.

Death Knight's Twin Axes.location: Dropped by the dual-axe Death Knight at the end of Fog Rift Catacombs.

Death's Poker.location: Dropped by the Death Rite Bird in Caelid, southeast of the Southern Aeonia Swamp Bank Site of Grace, at night.

Devourer's Scepter.location: Dropped by Knight Bernahl when killed - either at the Warmaster's Shack in Limgrave or during his invasion in Crumbling Farum Azula.

Digger's Staff.location: Drops from Glintstone Miners in crystal mines; Sellia Crystal Tunnel in Caelid is the earliest spot (also Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel, Altus Tunnel).

Dismounter.location: Drops from Kaiden Sellswords, e.g. on the path between Stormhill Shack and Warmaster's Shack, or at the camp northeast of Agheel Lake North.

Dragon Communion Seal.location: Dropped by a spectral Banished Knight in Fringefolk Hero's Grave (down the ramps from the Stranded Graveyard).

Dragon King's Cragblade.location: Trade the Remembrance of the Dragonlord (from Dragonlord Placidusax) to Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold.

Dragon-Hunter's Great Katana.location: Received for defeating the Ancient Dragon-Man at the end of the Dragon's Pit dungeon.

Dryleaf Arts.location: Won from Dryleaf Dane in an honorable duel at the Moorth Ruins Site of Grace (perform the 'May the Best Win' gesture before him).

Dryleaf Seal.location: On a cliff facing the river north of the Recluses' River Downstream Site of Grace.

Duelist Greataxe.location: Drops from Grave Warden Duelist enemies near the West Capital Rampart Site of Grace in Leyndell.

Eclipse Shotel.location: In front of the altar inside the Church of the Eclipse in Castle Sol.

Eleonora's Poleblade.location: Dropped by the invader Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger, at the Second Church of Marika.

Envoy's Greathorn.location: Chance to drop from Giant Oracle Envoy enemies (no single fixed location).

Envoy's Horn.location: Dropped by Oracle Envoy enemies that wield it (no single fixed location).

Envoy's Long Horn.location: Dropped by large Oracle Envoy enemies (no single fixed location).

Erdtree Greatbow.location: In Fringefolk Hero's Grave, obtained by destroying the chariot (drop an urn onto it), with 10 Great Arrows.

Estoc.location: Sold by the Nomadic Merchant in southern Liurnia near the Lake Shore for 3,000 Runes (also from Patches; Prisoner starting gear).

Euporia.location: Reached in Belurat/Enir-Ilim by dropping off the path past the lightning Divine Beast Warrior down to a balcony, then following the lifts past the Inquisitors and Divine Beast Warrior.

Executioner's Greataxe.location: Drops from greataxe-wielding Giant Skeletons, e.g. west of Church of Irith / near the tower southeast of Raya Lucaria in Liurnia.

Falchion.location: Drops from falchion-wielding Demi-Humans; six of nine in the group northeast of the Mistwood Outskirts Site of Grace carry it.

Falx.location: Guaranteed drop from Hornsent (hostile NPC) - looted near the Rauh Ancient Ruins Site of Grace or after Leda's boss fight in Shadow Keep / Ancient Ruins of Rauh / Enir-Ilim.

Family Heads.location: Dropped by Necromancer Garris, behind an illusory wall inside Sage's Cave, Altus Plateau.

Fire Knight's Shortsword.location: Drops from dual-dagger Fire Knights in the DLC (no single fixed location given).

Firespark Perfume Bottle.location: In a chest in the southeastern corner of the military encampment by the Castle Front Site of Grace.

Flail.location: In the black carriage furthest east at Gatefront Ruins.

Flamberge.location: Atop a tower right of the stairs to the Misbegotten Warrior & Crucible Knight courtyard in Redmane Castle, guarded by a Mad Pumpkin Head (after the festival).

Flowerstone Gavel.location: Where the Dragon Communion Priestess stood at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion after Bayle the Dread is defeated (if you did not give her Thiollier's Concoction).

Flowing Curved Sword.location: In a chest in a Great Coffin in the middle of the Consecrated Snowfield, southwest of the Inner Consecrated Snowfield Site of Grace.

Forked Greatsword.location: Drops from wolf-headed greatsword Imps; one is just down the stairs after the Road's End Catacombs grace. Also in many later catacombs.

Forked Hatchet.location: Drops from hatchet-wielding Fanged Imps; Stormfoot Catacombs is an easy early farm with two near the entrance grace.

Forked-Tongue Hatchet.location: Drops from hatchet-wielding Fanged Imps; earliest in Darklight Catacombs (also Fog Rift and Scorpion River Catacombs).

Frenzied Flame Seal.location: Obtained in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds by completing Hyetta's questline - accept the Three Fingers' blessing, then touch her.

Frenzyflame Perfume Bottle.location: On a seated corpse by the northern wall of the Church Ruins (Abandoned Church) in the Abyssal Woods.

Freyja's Greatsword.location: Dropped by Redmane Freyja - after the Leda and allies boss fight at the Specimen Storehouse (Shadow Keep) / Enir-Ilim, or near the Storehouse, Seventh Floor grace.

Frozen Needle.location: In a chest in Kingsrealm Ruins after defeating the Royal Revenant boss.

Full Moon Crossbow.location: In a chest atop a tower on the rooftops of Raya Lucaria.

Gargoyle's Black Axe.location: Dropped by the Black Blade Kindred before the Grand Lift of Rold, along with the Gargoyle's Black Blades.

Gargoyle's Black Blades.location: Guaranteed drop from the Black Blade Kindred before the Grand Lift of Rold, along with the Gargoyle's Black Axe.

Gargoyle's Black Halberd.location: Dropped by the Black Blade Kindred guarding the Bestial Sanctum, along with the Gargoyle's Blackblade.

Gargoyle's Blackblade.location: Dropped by the Black Blade Kindred outside the Bestial Sanctum, along with the Gargoyle's Black Halberd.

Gargoyle's Great Axe.location: Dropped by the Valiant Gargoyle just north of the Outer Wall Phantom Tree grace in Altus Plateau.

Gargoyle's Halberd.location: Dropped by the Gargoyle near the West Capital Rampart grace in Leyndell.

Gargoyle's Twinblade.location: Dropped by the Valiant Gargoyle duo boss (Nokron), along with the Gargoyle's Greatsword.

Gazing Finger.location: Trade the Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers (from Metyr) to Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold.

Gelmir Glintstone Staff.location: Drops from the egg-headed Man-Serpent near the throne in Volcano Manor, just before Rykard's teleporter.

Ghostflame Torch.location: On a corpse on the rooftops near the entrance of Nokron, Eternal City (two running jumps from the parapets).

Giant's Seal.location: Near a Fire Prelate inside Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave (reached via the hidden elevator compartment, then a ladder to the left).

Giant-Crusher.location: In a carriage south of the Outer Wall Phantom Tree grace in Altus Plateau.

Glaive.location: Drops from Graveyard Skeletons, such as the one near the Sellia Backstreets grace in Caelid.

Glintstone Kris.location: Received for siding with Sorceress Sellen against Castellan Jerren at the end of her questline (Raya Lucaria).

Glintstone Staff.location: Guaranteed drop from a Sorcerer Noble south of Waypoint Ruins, just west of the wolf graveyard.

Godskin Peeler.location: Dropped by the Godskin Apostle at the end of Dominula, Windmill Village.

Godskin Stitcher.location: Dropped by the Godskin Noble boss in Volcano Manor.

Golden Epitaph.location: At the entrance of Auriza Hero's Grave; requires a Stonesword Key and is guarded by a Basilisk.

Golden Halberd.location: Dropped by the Tree Sentinel boss in Limgrave (The First Step).

Golden Order Greatsword.location: Dropped by the Misbegotten Crusader at the end of the Cave of the Forlorn in the Consecrated Snowfield.

Golem Fist.location: Random drop from Golem Smiths at Taylew's Ruined Forge, Rauh Base.

Golem Greatbow.location: Drops from Guardian Golems that wield it across the Lands Between (e.g. the bridge to the Divine Tower of Limgrave) - no single fixed location.

Grafted Blade Greatsword.location: Dropped by the Leonine Misbegotten at the end of Castle Morne.

Grafted Dragon.location: Trade the Remembrance of the Grafted (from Godrick the Grafted) to Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold.

Grave Scythe.location: Drops from scythe-wielding Skeletons (no single fixed location).

Great Club.location: Dropped by the Stonedigger Troll inside Old Altus Tunnel (requires two Stonesword Keys).

Great Epee.location: In a chest by a tent in a campsite among the Fallen Ruins east of the Agheel Lake South Site of Grace, guarded by Kaiden Mercenaries and a Noble Sorcerer.

Great Knife.location: Drops from Small Demi-Humans; earliest just inside Lakeside Crystal Cave, with an efficient farm north of the Craftsman's Shack on Mt. Gelmir. Also Bandit starting gear.

Great Mace.location: In a chest among the trebuchets before the Grand Lift of Dectus in Liurnia.

Great Omenkiller Cleaver.location: Dropped by the Omenkiller & Miranda the Blighted Bloom duo in Perfumer's Grotto; also from an Omenkiller in Volcano Manor.

Great Stars.location: In a wandering caravan near the Road of Iniquity Side Path grace in Altus Plateau (also drops from Magnus the Beast Claw).

Greataxe.location: In a chest in a carriage hauled by two Trolls heading south on the road west of Waypoint Ruins.

Greathorn Hammer.location: Drops from Ancestral Follower Warriors that wield it (concentrated around Siofra River / the Ancestral Woods).

Greatsword of Damnation.location: Trade the Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flame (from Midra) to Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold.

Greatsword of Radahn (Light).location: Trade the Remembrance of a God and a Lord (from Promised Consort Radahn) to Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold.

Greatsword of Radahn (Lord).location: Trade the Remembrance of a God and a Lord (from Promised Consort Radahn) to Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold.

Greatsword of Solitude.location: Dropped by the Knight of the Solitary Gaol inside the Western Nameless Mausoleum.

Grossmesser.location: Drops from Skeletons; one is just past the grace in Tombsward Catacombs behind a Stonesword Key fog door. Also many later catacombs.

Guardian's Swordspear.location: ~2% drop from Erdtree Guardian enemies (no single fixed location).

Halberd.location: Sold by the Nomadic Merchant east of Saintsbridge in northern Limgrave; also Vagabond starting gear.

Halo Scythe.location: Drops from Cleanrot Knights that wield it (no single fixed location given).

Hammer.location: On the upper floor of the Fortified Manor, next to the Sanctified Whetblade.

Hand Axe.location: Sold for 600 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant in eastern Limgrave (Mistwood, south of the Minor Erdtree).

Hand Ballista.location: In a chest atop the Forest Lookout Tower in the Weeping Peninsula, southwest of the Bridge of Sacrifice.

Harp Bow.location: On a cliff east of Sainted Hero's Grave (after examining the Champion's Song painting inside the Shaded Castle wall).

Heavy Crossbow.location: Drops from crossbow-wielding Soldiers; three Godrick Soldiers just northwest of Gatefront Ruins are an early source.

Helphen's Steeple.location: Dropped by a Tibia Mariner overlooking Castle Sol, near the Snow Valley Ruins Overlook Site of Grace.

Horned Warrior's Greatsword.location: Dropped by the wind-aspected Divine Beast Warrior near the end of Enir-Ilim, on the bridge to the Cleansing Chamber Anteroom grace.

Hoslow's Petal Whip.location: Dropped by Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood, after invading him for Tanith's final Volcano Manor contract.

Icerind Hatchet.location: In a chest in a small broken tower in southern Temple Quarter, southwest of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

Igon's Greatbow.location: Recovered from Igon's corpse after completing his questline or killing him (notably on Jagged Peak after the Bayle fight).

Inquisitor's Girandole.location: Dropped by the Abductor Virgin duo boss in Volcano Manor.

Inseparable Sword.location: Guaranteed drop after the death of D, Beholder of Death, in the Siofra Aqueduct (or Deeproot Depths, depending on the questline path).

Iron Ball.location: Received from Blackguard Big Boggart when he is killed (he is first met at the Boilprawn Shack in Liurnia).

Iron Cleaver.location: Drops from cleaver-wielding Misbegotten; ~8 gather at the pyre reached from the Castle Morne Lift grace.

Iron Spear.location: Dropped by spear-wielding Fallen Hawk Soldiers near the Nokron, Eternal City grace.

Ivory Sickle.location: Found near the Village of the Albinaurics Site of Grace in Liurnia.

Jar Cannon.location: Dropped by Demi-Human Queen Margot inside Volcano Cave.

Jawbone Axe.location: Drops from axe-wielding Ancestral Follower Warriors, e.g. northwest of Worshippers' Woods in lower Siofra River.

Katar.location: In a chest in Fort Gael, Caelid.

Knight's Greatsword.location: Drops from sword-wielding knights; two Godrick Knights are at the camp between the Warmaster's Shack and Saintsbridge. Also many later knights.

Lamenting Visage.location: In Lamenter's Gaol (from Charo's Hidden Grave): from the Living Jar Warrior pit, take the first door left, pass an illusory wall, and open the locked door with the Gaol Lower Level Key.

Lance.location: On a corpse on a squarish ruin northeast of the Warmaster's Shack.

Large Club.location: On a corpse near a group of Demi-Humans south of the Forlorn Hound Evergaol.

Lazuli Glintstone Sword.location: Drops from Lazuli Glintstone Sorcerers; one is just outside the Schoolhouse Classroom grace, before the Red Wolf of Radagon.

Leda's Sword.location: Received after defeating Leda and her allies near the top of Enir-Ilim.

Light Crossbow.location: Sold for 1,500 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant at the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace.

Lightning Perfume Bottle.location: In a small pond surrounded by Lightning Sheep southeast of the Ellac River Downstream grace / northeast of the Cerulean Coast grace.

Lion Greatbow.location: Trade the Remembrance of the Starscourge (from Starscourge Radahn) to Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold.

Lizard Greatsword.location: Drops from greatsword-wielding lion-headed Imps in Fog Rift Catacombs (and Scorpion River Catacombs).

Longbow.location: Sold by the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 1,200 Runes; also Samurai starting gear and a Skeleton drop.

Longhaft Axe.location: Drops from larger Scaly Misbegotten; found at Castle Morne and Morne Tunnel, plus later areas.

Lordsworn's Greatsword.location: In the chest on a carriage just southeast of the Gatefront Site of Grace.

Lordsworn's Straight Sword.location: Drops from soldiers; farmable at Gatefront Ruins from Godrick Soldiers, or two Mausoleum Soldiers outside the Fourth Church of Marika.

Lucerne.location: Near a broken wagon north of the Liurnia Highway North grace.

Lusat's Glintstone Staff.location: In a chest after the Nox Swordstress & Nox Monk fight in Sellia, Town of Sorcery.

Mace.location: Sold by the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 800 Runes.

Madding Hand.location: Dropped by an unmarked optional boss south of the Woodland Trail grace in the Abyssal Woods.

Magma Whip Candlestick.location: Reward from Patches in Volcano Manor after defeating Great Horned Tragoth (reload and speak to him again).

Main-gauche.location: On a body in a small room with a Black Knight, up the western stairs from the Main Gate Plaza Site of Grace.

Mantis Blade.location: Dropped by a Cemetery Shade in a nook in Gelmir Hero's Grave, just before the final lava stretch.

Marais Executioner's Sword.location: Dropped by Elemer of the Briar at the top of the Shaded Castle.

Maternal Staff.location: Dropped by Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers, in the Cathedral of Manus Metyr, after slaying Metyr, Mother of Fingers.

Messmer Soldier's Axe.location: Drops from axe-wielding Messmer Soldiers; e.g. at Fog Rift Fort or outside Castle Ensis at the Castle Front grace.

Messmer Soldier's Spear.location: Drops from spear-wielding Messmer Soldiers; three are at a camp west of the Moorth Ruins grace.

Milady.location: In a chest atop a watchtower in Castle Ensis, reached by dropping from the Castle-Lord's Chamber balcony down the rock faces, then up stairs and ladders.

Mohgwyn's Sacred Spear.location: Trade the Remembrance of the Blood Lord (from Mohg, Lord of Blood) to Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold.

Monk's Flameblade.location: Drops from a sword-wielding Flame Monk in Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave (behind an illusory wall and flame trap).

Monk's Flamemace.location: Drops from Fire Monk enemies, notably in Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave.

Moonrithyll's Knight Sword.location: Dropped by Moonrithyll, Carian Knight, who invades on the path between the Castle Ensis Checkpoint and Castle-Lord's Chamber graces.

Morgott's Cursed Sword.location: Trade the Remembrance of the Omen King (from Morgott) to Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold.

Nagakiba.location: Dropped by Bloody Finger Hunter Yura at the end of his questline (Second Church of Marika), or after defeating him; via Frenzied Flame ending, where Shabriri stood near the Zamor Ruins.

Nanaya's Torch.location: On a body inside Midra's Manse; from Midra's Library grace, cross the rafters west and pull the lever behind an illusory painting.

Nightrider Glaive.location: Dropped by a Night's Cavalry north of the East Raya Lucaria Gate grace (only appears at night), with the Ash of War: Giant Hunt.

Noble's Estoc.location: Low drop chance from Wandering Nobles in Aristocrat garb; two are north of the Mistwood Outskirts Site of Grace.

Nox Flowing Hammer.location: On a corpse in Night's Sacred Ground, Nokron, near the Mimic Tear Ashes.

Nox Flowing Sword.location: Dropped by the Nox Swordstress & Nox Monk duo in Sellia, Town of Sorcery (light the three braziers to remove the seal).

Obsidian Lamina.location: Recovered from Sir Ansbach's body near the Promised Consort Radahn arena, after assisting him against Leda at the Specimen Storehouse.

Omen Cleaver.location: Just outside the Liftside Chamber Site of Grace in Stormveil Castle, beside a Stray; also drops from Omens in catacombs.

Onyx Lord's Greatsword.location: Dropped by the Onyx Lord boss at the end of the Sealed Tunnel in Capital Outskirts.

Ordovis's Greatsword.location: Dropped by the Crucible Knight Ordovis & Crucible Knight duo at the bottom of Auriza Hero's Grave.

Ornamental Straight Sword.location: Dropped by the Grafted Scion at the Chapel of Anticipation (beat it at game start, or revisit via the Four Belfries in west Liurnia).

Parrying Dagger.location: Drops from various dagger enemies; obtainable early at Stormveil Castle (also sold/looted across the Lands Between).

Partisan.location: Drops from knight enemies, e.g. the Godrick Knight at Gatefront Ruins, or Leyndell Knights near the Ninth Mt. Gelmir Campsite.

Pata.location: On a corpse on a ledge by the front entrance to the Church of Benediction.

Pest's Glaive.location: Chance to drop from Kindred of Rot enemies (no single fixed location).

Pickaxe.location: Drops from Miners in mining galleries throughout the Lands Between (no single fixed location).

Pike.location: On a corpse in the open courtyard with flamethrower enemies in Stormveil Castle.

Poleblade of the Bud.location: Trade the Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud (from Romina) to Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold.

Prelate's Inferno Crozier.location: Dropped by a Fire Prelate in Fort Laiedd, west of Volcano Manor on Mt. Gelmir (one per playthrough).

Pulley Bow.location: On a corpse up a tower near the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite grace.

Pulley Crossbow.location: On a corpse on the wooden platforms just outside the Craftsman's Shack Site of Grace.

Putrescence Cleaver.location: Trade the Remembrance of Putrescence (from the Putrescent Knight) to Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold.

Queelign's Greatsword.location: Obtained in the Shadow Keep after giving Fire Knight Queelign the Iris of Occultation.

Rabbath's Cannon.location: In the study of Rabbath's Rise; reach it via a nearby Sealed Spiritspring or by descending from the cliffs southeast of Shaman Village.

Rakshasa's Great Katana.location: Dropped by Rakshasa in the Eastern Nameless Mausoleum.

Raptor Talons.location: In a chest behind an illusory wall beyond a four-skeleton room inside Sage's Cave, Altus Plateau.

Red Bear's Claw.location: Dropped by the Red Bear NPC boss in the Northern Nameless Mausoleum (accessed via Rauh Base).

Red Branch Shortbow.location: Drops from Pages and Noble Pages, e.g. at Tombsward Ruins (also Raya Lucaria, Caria Manor, Redmane Castle and later areas).

Reduvia.location: Dropped by Bloody Finger Nerijus, who invades near Murkwater Cave.

Regalia of Eochaid.location: On a ledge at the beach bordering Caelid and Limgrave, east of the Third Church of Marika (reached via Gaol Cave or tricky jumps).

Repeating Crossbow.location: Alongside the road just south of the Ghostflame Dragon north of the Moorth Highway, South grace, southwest of Moorth Ruins.

Ringed Finger.location: In a chest inside Gelmir Hero's Grave on Mt. Gelmir.

Ripple Blade.location: Sold by Pidia, Carian Servant, for 3,500 Runes on the hidden floor behind Caria Manor (after Royal Knight Loretta).

Ripple Crescent Halberd.location: Dropped by Albinauric enemies that wield it (no single fixed location).

Rosus' Axe.location: Inside Black Knife Catacombs in northeast Liurnia (requires one Stonesword Key).

Rotten Battle Hammer.location: Dropped by a Rotten Duelist west of the Consecrated Snowfield grace.

Rotten Crystal Staff.location: Drops from Putrid Crystalian Mages, e.g. near the Elphael Inner Wall grace in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree.

Rotten Crystal Sword.location: In a chest guarded by three Crystalians behind tree roots right after the Elphael Inner Wall grace in Elphael.

Rotten Greataxe.location: Dropped by a Rotten Duelist northwest of Ordina, Liturgical Town.

Rotten Staff.location: Dropped by the Putrid/scarlet-rot Erdtree Avatar patrolling the bridge in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree.

Royal Greatsword.location: Dropped by Blaidd at Ranni's Rise after completing Ranni's questline.

Ruins Greatsword.location: Dropped by the Misbegotten Warrior & Crucible Knight duo at Redmane Castle plaza (when the festival is inactive).

Rusted Anchor.location: Dropped by the Scaly Misbegotten area boss in Morne Tunnel.

Scepter of the All-Knowing.location: Dropped by Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing, when defeated in Leyndell, Ashen Capital.

Scorpion's Stinger.location: In a chest in a small shrine west of the Grand Cloister grace at the Lake of Rot, guarded by Kindred of Rot.

Scythe.location: On a body on the upper floor of Cliffbottom Catacombs in southeast Liurnia, guarded by four stone Imps.

Sentry's Torch.location: Sold by the Hermit Merchant at the Hermit Merchant's Shack for 7,000 Runes.

Serpent Bow.location: Inside the Abandoned Cave in Caelid.

Serpent Flail.location: In a chest within Fog Rift Fort.

Serpent-God's Curved Sword.location: On a balcony in the Ruin-Strewn Precipice in Liurnia.

Serpent-Hunter.location: Picked up within the boss arena of Praetor Rykard in Volcano Manor.

Shamshir.location: On a corpse on the largest pillar in the water inside Highroad Cave, guarded by two Giant Bats.

Short Spear.location: Sold by the Twin Maiden Husks for 600 Runes; also Prophet starting gear and a Godrick Foot Soldier drop.

Short Sword.location: Sold by the Nomadic Merchant east of Saintsbridge for 600 Runes; also Astrologer starting gear.

Shortbow.location: Sold by the Nomadic Merchant in western Limgrave (southeast of Coastal Cave) for 600 Runes; also Bandit starting gear.

Shotel.location: Sold by the Abandoned Merchant in lower Siofra River (west of Worshippers' Woods) for 2,500 Runes.

Siluria's Tree.location: Dropped by Crucible Knight Siluria in Deeproot Depths.

Smithscript Axe.location: In a room with a Golem Smith reached by jumping the gap on the straight path from the Taylew's Ruined Forge grace, then taking a left.

Smithscript Cirque.location: On a body by the sewage waterfall in the depths of Ruined Forge of Starfall Past, behind a lever-locked gate.

Smithscript Dagger.location: Behind the Golem Smith on the floor below the lava-pipe lever in Ruined Forge Lava Intake.

Smithscript Greathammer.location: Found at Taylew's Ruined Forge, Rauh Base.

Smithscript Spear.location: On a body on the main floor of Ruined Forge of Starfall Past.

Soldier's Crossbow.location: Drops from crossbow-wielding foot soldiers; an early farm is the cliff overlooking the Saintsbridge grace, but found from Weeping Peninsula onward.

Spear.location: Drops from Exile Soldiers in Stormveil Castle; +7 version from Patches' questline.

Spiked Caestus.location: Sold by the Isolated Merchant in Caelid for 4,000 Runes.

Spiked Club.location: Chance to drop from Demi-Human enemies that wield it (no single fixed location).

Spiked Spear.location: Drops from spear-wielding Marionette Soldier enemies (no single fixed location).

Spiraltree Seal.location: Reward from 'The Sacred Tower' painting; after burning the Sealing Tree past the Church of the Bud, the painter relocates south of the Northern Nameless Mausoleum.

Spirit Glaive.location: On a grave at the edge of Gravesite Plain; from Charo's Hidden Grave, go through the northwest arch, turn right, and follow the path up north.

Spirit Sword.location: In a ravine behind the stranded coffin boat northeast of the Cerulean Coast West Site of Grace, in the far right corner near gravestones.

Spread Crossbow.location: On a corpse in a ruined campsite by the cliffs facing the Ellac River, south of the Castle Front encampment.

St. Trina's Torch.location: In one of the Troll-drawn carriages in the southeast Snowfield, northeast of the Consecrated Snowfield grace.

Staff of Loss.location: On a corpse on a balcony in northwestern Sellia, Town of Sorcery, eastern Caelid.

Staff of the Avatar.location: Dropped by an Erdtree Avatar near the Great Waterfall Crest grace in Deeproot Depths.

Steel-Wire Torch.location: At the end of a narrow path guarded by two Misbegotten on the north side of Castle Morne's top level (from the Castle Morne Lift).

Stone Club.location: Chance to drop from Battlemage enemies that wield it (no single fixed location).

Stone-Sheathed Sword.location: Found at an altar in Fog Rift Catacombs (or Ruins of Unte / Ancient Ruins of Rauh).

Stormhawk Axe.location: In the court outside the Fortified Manor where the Abductor Virgins roam in Leyndell; also in Castle Sol and from Nepheli Loux.

Swift Spear.location: On a corpse guarded by three Messmer Soldiers along the road southeast of the Castle Front Site of Grace.

Sword of Darkness.location: Transform the Stone-Sheathed Sword (or Sword of Light) at the altar in Fog Rift Catacombs or Ruins of Unte.

Sword of Light.location: Transform the Stone-Sheathed Sword at the altar in Fog Rift Catacombs or Ancient Ruins of Rauh.

Sword of Night.location: Dropped by Jolan, Swordhand of Night, at the Cathedral of Manus Metyr after Count Ymir's questline - give her the Iris of Occultation.

Sword of Night and Flame.location: In a chest in a locked tower room at Caria Manor, jumped into from the walkways above where the Raya Lucaria puppets appear.

Sword of St. Trina.location: Behind a Stonesword Key imp statue in the Forsaken Ruins, Caelid, below the Rotview Balcony Site of Grace.

Thiollier's Hidden Needle.location: Recovered from Thiollier's body at the end of his questline.

Thorned Whip.location: Drops from Fire Prelate enemies that wield it (Mt. Gelmir, Mountaintops of the Giants, Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave).

Tooth Whip.location: On a corpse inside the Whipping Hut in Scadu Altus.

Torch.location: Bought from Merchant Kale at the Church of Elleh for 200 Runes.

Torchpole.location: Dropped by Exile Soldiers that wield it in Stormveil Castle.

Troll Knight's Sword.location: Guaranteed drop from the Troll Knight in Caria Manor just before Royal Knight Loretta; also farmable at Converted Fringe Tower and the Four Belfries.

Troll's Golden Sword.location: In a chest in a carriage in a Leyndell Soldier camp between the Erdtree-Gazing Hill and Altus Highway Junction graces.

Troll's Hammer.location: On a corpse inside Old Altus Tunnel (requires two Stonesword Keys).

Twinblade.location: In a chest in the southeastern basement room of the Dragon-Burnt Ruins, reached by jumping over a crumbled wall with Torrent.

Twinned Knight Swords.location: On a corpse just northwest of the East Windmill Pasture in Altus Plateau.

Urumi.location: On a corpse up on the rooftops of Caria Manor in Liurnia.

Varre's Bouquet.location: Drops from White Mask Varre at the end of his questline; touch his invasion sign near the Dynasty Mausoleum Midpoint grace and defeat him, then exhaust his dialogue.

Velvet Sword of St. Trina.location: Furthest inside a slime-filled cave south of the Fissure Cross Site of Grace (drop down two stone platforms to a lower cliff).

Veteran's Prosthesis.location: Dropped by Commander Niall in Castle Sol.

Vulgar Militia Saw.location: Dropped by Vulgar Militia enemies that wield it (no single fixed location given).

Vulgar Militia Shotel.location: Dropped by Vulgar Militia enemies that wield it (no single fixed location given).

Vyke's War Spear.location: Dropped by Festering Fingerprint Vyke, who invades at the Church of Inhibition in Liurnia.

Wakizashi.location: Drops from various enemies; obtainable from soldiers around Stormveil Castle / Limgrave (also a Foot Soldier drop).

Warhawk's Talon.location: Drops from Warhawks; four are on the walls outside the Rampart Tower Site of Grace in Stormveil Castle (also Castle Sol).

Warped Axe.location: Drops from axe-wielding Omens; two are in Cliffbottom Catacombs and two near the Abandoned Coffin grace by the Ruin-Strewn Precipice.

Warpick.location: Drops from soldiers of every faction that wield it (2%); found from Limgrave onward.

Watchdog's Greatsword.location: Drops from non-boss Erdtree Burial Watchdogs in Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave and Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs (also Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs).

Weathered Straight Sword.location: Drops from Commoner enemies in Stormveil Castle, e.g. the three by the fireplace in the Grafted Scion room.

Whip.location: In the second prison cell area of Castle Morne, reached by dropping onto beams; the room is full of rats and a Misbegotten.

Winged Greathorn.location: Trade the Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor (from the Regal Ancestor Spirit) to Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold.

Winged Scythe.location: Underground in the Tombsward Ruins on the Weeping Peninsula.

Zamor Curved Sword.location: Dropped by the Ancient Hero of Zamor at the end of Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave.

Shadow Sunflower Blossom.location: Trade the Remembrance of the Shadow Sunflower (from the Scadutree Avatar) to Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold.

[NPC] Ansbach's Longbow.location: Obtained from assisting either Ansbach or Leda in their confrontation at the Specimen Storehouse (Shadow Keep).

[NPC] Beast Claw.location: Dropped by Logur, the Beast Claw, in southern Gravesite Plain on the way to the Church of Consolation.

[NPC] Bonny Butchering Knife.location: Loot below a small shed outside a house east of the Bonny Village Site of Grace in Scadu Altus.

[NPC] Clawmark Seal.location: Given by Gurranq, Beast Clergyman at the Bestial Sanctum after feeding him 1 Deathroot.

[NPC] Claws of Night.location: Dropped by the invading Swordhand of Night Anna on the approach to the hanging bell of the Finger Ruins.

[NPC] Dancing Blade of Ranah.location: Dropped by the Dancer of Ranah inside the Southern Nameless Mausoleum.

[NPC] Dane's Footwork.location: Pillaged from Dryleaf Dane's corpse after the Leda and allies boss fight in Enir-Ilim.

[NPC] Deadly Poison Perfume Bottle.location: Purchased from Thiollier (or later Moore / the Twin Maiden Husks) for 6,000 Runes.

[NPC] Dragon Communion Seal.location: Dropped by a spectral Banished Knight in Fringefolk Hero's Grave.

[NPC] Dragon-Hunter's Great Katana.location: Received for defeating the Ancient Dragon-Man at the end of the Dragon's Pit dungeon.

[NPC] Dryleaf Arts.location: Won from Dryleaf Dane in an honorable duel at the Moorth Ruins Site of Grace.

[NPC] Dryleaf Seal.location: On a cliff facing the river north of the Recluses' River Downstream Site of Grace.

[NPC] Erdtree Seal.location: In an open cell just northwest of the Prison Town Church Site of Grace in Volcano Manor, near an Omenkiller.

[NPC] Falx.location: Guaranteed drop from Hornsent (hostile NPC); looted near the Rauh Ancient Ruins grace or after Leda's boss fight.

[NPC] Fire Knight's Seal.location: After draining the water from the Church District, behind the decapitated Marika statue in the largest church, guarded by Wego, Fire Knight Elder.

[NPC] Flowerstone Gavel.location: Where the Dragon Communion Priestess stood at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion after Bayle the Dread is defeated.

[NPC] Frenzied Flame Seal.location: Obtained in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds by completing Hyetta's questline (accept the Three Fingers, then touch her).

[NPC] Freyja's Greatsword.location: Dropped by Redmane Freyja after the Leda and allies boss fight at the Specimen Storehouse, or near the Storehouse, Seventh Floor grace.

[NPC] Gravel Stone Seal.location: Dropped by a spear-wielding Leyndell Knight just to the left outside the front gate of the Fortified Manor.

[NPC] Greatsword of Solitude.location: Dropped by the Knight of the Solitary Gaol inside the Western Nameless Mausoleum.

[NPC] Igon's Greatbow.location: Recovered from Igon's corpse after his questline or killing him (notably on Jagged Peak after the Bayle fight).

[NPC] Leda's Sword.location: Received after defeating Leda and her allies near the top of Enir-Ilim.

[NPC] Madding Hand.location: Dropped by an unmarked optional boss south of the Woodland Trail grace in the Abyssal Woods.

[NPC] Maternal Staff.location: Dropped by Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers, in the Cathedral of Manus Metyr after slaying Metyr.

[NPC] Moonrithyll's Knight Sword.location: Dropped by Moonrithyll, Carian Knight, who invades between the Castle Ensis Checkpoint and Castle-Lord's Chamber graces.

[NPC] Obsidian Lamina.location: Recovered from Sir Ansbach's body near the Promised Consort Radahn arena after assisting him against Leda.

[NPC] Queelign's Greatsword.location: Obtained in the Shadow Keep after giving Fire Knight Queelign the Iris of Occultation.

[NPC] Rakshasa's Great Katana.location: Dropped by Rakshasa in the Eastern Nameless Mausoleum.

[NPC] Rapier.location: Sold by the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 1,000 Runes.

[NPC] Red Bear's Claw.location: Dropped by the Red Bear NPC boss in the Northern Nameless Mausoleum (accessed via Rauh Base).

[NPC] Reduvia.location: Dropped by Bloody Finger Nerijus, who invades near Murkwater Cave.

[NPC] Repeating Crossbow.location: Alongside the road just south of the Ghostflame Dragon north of the Moorth Highway, South grace.

[NPC] Sword of Night.location: Dropped by Jolan, Swordhand of Night, at the Cathedral of Manus Metyr after Count Ymir's questline (give her the Iris of Occultation).

[NPC] Thiollier's Hidden Neddle.location: Recovered from Thiollier's body at the end of his questline (Thiollier's Hidden Needle).
